name: Creative Opps Oracle
tagline: Rounds up open calls, grants and paid gigs that fit one artist's practice
description: A talent-scout desk for a single working independent artist. It starts by auditing your public presence so it knows how you actually work, then rounds up what is currently open - calls for work, grants, residencies and paid gigs - across art, music, code, games, film and writing. One artist at a time.
author: EmpressTrash
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
